headline: War 140 Day Eight: Colonials Gain Ground Central Front
war_summary: Five hours after the last edition the central corridor has shifted markedly toward the Colonials. In the four core regions — Dead Lands, Drowned Vale, Farranac Coast and Endless Shore — Colonial forces now hold twenty‑eight of forty‑four strategic bases, with the Dead Lands still split five to six and the Endless Shore dead‑even at five each. The Drowned Vale and Farranac Coast have seen the heaviest base turnover in the past day, recording twenty and sixteen ownership changes respectively, while the Endless Shore logged thirty‑two captures and the Dead Lands five. To the north, Clahstra has fallen completely to Colonial control, whereas Linn Mercy remains an all‑Warden stronghold; Kingscage leans Colonial seven to one and the Fingers stay contested three to four. The peripheral arcs are unchanged: Colonials retain the western and southern belt from Acrithia through Umbral Wildwood, and Wardens hold the northern and eastern stretch from Basin Sionnach to the Weathered Expanse. Casualty rates have cooled in the last hour but accelerated over the most recent two‑hour window across all active fronts, and enlistments show a similar pattern — overall decline but a sharp two‑hour uptick, signalling fresh reinforcements arriving at the hottest sectors.
